notes.subject: hesed
notes.rationale: Hesed kept as loanword; no single Bambara word carries covenant-loyalty plus kindness.

notes.subject: sinsinniya
notes.rationale: אמונה is firmness/reliability; 'sinsinniya' (steadfastness) is the closest shape.

notes.subject: sɔgɔma/suw
notes.rationale: Hebrew pairs boqer (morning) against plural leilot (nights); the plural is kept as suw.

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Direct second-person address to Yawe continues.

translation: Ka i ka hesed jira sɔgɔma fɛ, ani i ka sinsinniya suw la.
